summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with 4+ years building production-ready React applications in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with strong TypeScript experience and a sharp eye for accessibility and performance. Skilled across the modern frontend ecosystem, including Webpack-based build tooling, responsive interfaces, and browser fundamentals, while collaborating cross-functionally to ship reusable, scalable frontend components. Track record of driving measurable business outcomes and raising code quality through design-system work and architectural RFCs. Mentors junior engineers and stays ahead of AI-native development workflows.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Architected a reusable, scalable frontend component - an interactive split-shipment tree view for complex multi-leg shipments - owning recursive tree state management, async data synchronisation, and cross-component state sharing, driving a $1.2M ARR uplift in collaboration with design, backend, and product.
Contributed to a React Aria-based design system, establishing accessible, reusable component patterns adopted across multiple microfrontends.

Led the migration of the legacy Last Mile application to the modern frontend stack, rewriting the entire UI layer and progressively rolling it out to 100% of customers - a seamless cutover with no disruption to existing workflows.
Mentored junior engineers through feature ownership and unblocking cross-team dependencies, and shaped team-level frontend engineering best practices via architectural RFCs.
Improved performance and reduced costs by consolidating redundant per-page Mapbox map instances into a single shared instance reused across the application.
Owned the bulk carrier CSV upload experience supporting up to 10,000 shipments - client-side parsing, file preview, and per-row inline error feedback - reducing churn by 1.5%.

Extended Figma's MCP (Figma-to-code) integration with codebase conventions - module structure, shared-component usage, hooks, data-fetching, and testing standards - as AI context, reducing design-to-code handoff time across frontend teams.

experience.title: Software Engineer 2
bullets: Improved Core Web Vitals (LCP, TTI) - key browser performance metrics - for Practo's Care product, increasing leads by 22%.
Added adaptive video streaming and image stories to the Doctor Profile, driving more user traffic and increasing conversion by 18%.
